name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: Reports from the Tower of Althalaxx lead south into Ashenvale, where the Cult of the Dark Strand also threatens the woods. Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post sends you to the ruins of Ordil'Aran to recover a Glowing Soul Gem.

sections.title: A Plea Across the Border
sections.body: After the trouble around the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, reports lead south to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post. The Cult of the Dark Strand is pressing into the ancient elven woods, and Delgren has fought them for a long time. Their reach crosses both territories, so he seeks to strike at the source of their sorcery.

sections.title: The Secrets of Ordil'Aran
sections.body: The ruins of Ordil'Aran lie northeast of Maestra's Post, overrun by Dark Strand cultists. Delgren says their operatives carry glowing soul gems, vessels enchanted with magic that sustains the cult's power. Hunt the cultists among the ruins and recover one of the gems so Delgren can break its enchantment and uncover the source of their rite.

sections.title: A Spirit Trapped
sections.body: Delgren finds a tormented spirit bound inside the Glowing Soul Gem. When its wards break, Sargath appears, one of the elves of Ameth'Aran whom Athrikus Narassin trapped in soul gems during the Sundering and has slowly drained ever since. Sargath names Athrikus's lieutenant, Ilkrud Magthrull, whose tome may reveal where the remaining soul gems are held.

faq.q: Where do I find the Glowing Soul Gem?
faq.answer: Cult of the Dark Strand members in the ruins of Ordil'Aran northeast of Maestra's Post carry Glowing Soul Gems. The ruins are in Ashenvale, and you may need to search several cultists to recover one.
Delgren the Purifier is an Alliance champion stationed at Maestra's Post in northern Ashenvale. He fights forces invading the forest, especially the Cult of the Dark Strand.

faq.q: What is the Cult of the Dark Strand?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand is a sect based in the Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore and in ancient elven ruins such as Ordil'Aran in Ashenvale. Its members practice dark sorcery, soul binding, and necromantic rites.

faq.q: Why is a Darkshore quest sending me to Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand's reach crosses from the Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore into Ashenvale. Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post knows how to oppose the cult's soul-binding magic.

faq.q: What happens when the soul gem is deciphered?
aliases: what is in the soul gem
faq.answer: Delgren plans to decipher the dark enchantment on the Glowing Soul Gem. What he finds becomes clear after you bring it to him.
Ordil'Aran is an ancient elven ruin northeast of Maestra's Post in northern Ashenvale. The Cult of the Dark Strand has overrun it.

angles.text: As a paladin, purging unholy corruption from the world includes destroying dark soul vessels and fighting the cultists who twist them.
As a priest, examining a dark soul vessel reflects your calling to oppose corruption and comfort tormented souls.
As a night elf, you see the Cult of the Dark Strand defile ancient ruins like Ordil'Aran and corrupt the northern woods. Removing them is urgent.
As an Alliance member, you help outposts in Darkshore and Ashenvale protect the northern frontier from dark practitioners who threaten Alliance travelers.
